facts.fact: PLAC Legist says the Cybercrimes Act as amended in February 2024 requires operators of computer systems to report attacks to the National CERT Coordination Center through sectoral CERTs, and makes the Office of the National Security Adviser responsible for establishing sectoral CERTs and security operations centres that feed into the national CERT.

systems.country_label: National Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT) Coordination Center
systems.owner: Office of the National Security Adviser

facts.fact: PLAC Legist says the Cybercrimes Act of 2015 was amended by a bill passed by the Senate on 21 December 2023 and the House on 14 February 2024 and assented to by President Tinubu in February 2024.

PLAC Legist describes the Nigeria Data Protection Act as recently enacted and the key legislation on data protection in the country, and says the 2024 Cybercrimes amendment ties traffic data retention to it.

PLAC Legist says the Cybercrimes Act as amended in 2024 sets which contractual transactions and declarations are valid by electronic signature in section 17, so electronic signatures have legal effect under it.

facts.fact: PLAC Legist says the Cybercrimes Act amendment passed in December 2023 and February 2024 in secrecy and with no public participation, causing a national outcry.
